## Summary

Describe the problem and the change made to solve it.

## Related issue

Link the issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and the results.

```text
Example:
- dotnet test CareBridge.sln
- cd src/web/carebridge-ui && npm run lint
- cd src/web/carebridge-ui && npm run build
```

## Screenshots or recordings

Include visuals for UI changes when they help reviewers.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated edits.
- [ ] I updated documentation where behavior, commands, contracts, or architecture changed.
- [ ] I added or updated tests when behavior changed, or explained why tests were not needed.
- [ ] I removed secrets and sensitive information from code, logs, screenshots, and fixtures.
- [ ] I did not add real patient data or make misleading production-readiness claims.
- [ ] I called out breaking changes, schema changes, or infrastructure changes explicitly.
